title: Portal Security: Account-Wide Case Access on Customer Community Licenses

steps.prompt: An Experience Cloud site serves customers on Customer Community licenses. Each user must read every Case on their own Account, including Cases their coworkers opened. Which sharing mechanism should the architect use?

options.label: Apex managed sharing that writes a CaseShare row per user and Case
options.rationale: Customer Community users sit outside the standard sharing model, so share rows are not how they gain access; their access comes from Account and Contact lookup matches.

options.label: A criteria-based sharing rule that grants Cases to a public group of site users
options.rationale: Sharing rules work through the roles and groups of the standard sharing model, which Customer Community licenses do not use because they do not support roles.

options.label: A sharing set that matches each user's Account to the Case's Account
options.rationale: Customer Community licenses do not support roles, so they rely on a sharing model that matches the user to Account and Contact lookups on the record. Matching on the Case's Account reaches Cases opened by every coworker at that Account.
